profile.headline: Software Engineer at Indeed.com
profile.summary: Software engineer/economist passionate about making the world a better place through data and tech.

positions.title: Software Development Student
positions.description:
Intensive full-stack web development education focused on building skilled and work-tested software engineers

• Cover computer science fundamentals, Python, Flask, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React 
• Full-stack projects focus on agile development, test-driven development, pair/group programming, and independent learning
• Capstone Project: Self-directed full-stack iOS app that connects to Google Calendar and lets users automate custom event notifications (Tech stack: Swift/SwiftUI, flask API, Firebase authorization, FireStore database)

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Gathered and analyzed messy data through ETLs (Excel, SQL, Access)
• Developed and monitored key performance indicators, created dashboards, and wrote valuable reports (scheduled and ad hoc) through cross-team collaboration
• Presented findings to IT heads and business partners guiding data-driven decisions
• Assisted go-live efforts during major software deployment

positions.title: Medical Record Data Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Critically analyzed files on four Electronic Medical Record systems to ensure legacy data
• Markedly reduced duplicate data

positions.title: Digital Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
• Forecasted business trends based on internal and external data
• Created steered online content and promotional material, administered social media presence, significantly increased newsletter interaction, and analyzed cost options
• Communicated with registered and potential students through direct communication and steered content

positions.title: Intern for the Office of Management and Budget
positions.description:
• Analyzed, organized, and indexed large sets of archives, invoices, and data sets
• Quickly adapted to new roles in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Grants, Open Records and Archives, Purchasing, and Fiscal Administration
• Communicated with a broad range of people served by the government in person, through the phone, and through email.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
• Increased number of active members and level of involvement with a focus on diversity (from 5 weekly attendees to an average of 30)
• Selected pertinent topics and presenters, led weekly meetings, moderated challenging conversations, and organized events
• Designed current logo, website, and newsletter

positions.title: Vice President of Internal Affairs
positions.description: • Organizational outreach and collaboration through meaningful relationships with a focus on community and activism

company.name: University of Kentucky Latino Student Union

positions.title: Wildcat Ambassador
positions.description: Lead campus tour groups, participated in student panels with large audiences (300+ people), and individually met with families and prospective students to share experiences and answer questions about UK
